theater: 南陽郡治宛城與義陽、壽春前線

battle.name: 南陽之戰
battle.theater: 南陽郡治宛城與義陽、壽春前線
battle.brief: 公元497年，南齊永明九年，北魏孝文帝向江淮用兵，直指南陽郡治宛城。南齊以太傅蕭道成主持的邊軍據城固守，以弩砲與淮漢水網拖住魏軍騎兵；魏軍糧道受制、攻城器械不備，退回淮北。希臘重步兵不在此戰，但那面互相遮蔽的圓盾點出同一道理：面對衝鋒，要靠貼身盾牆把對手的速度換成自己的厚度。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 南陽之戰是公元497年南齊與北魏在南陽、義陽一帶的邊境戰役，交戰雙方分別是建康的南齊與遷都洛陽不久的北魏。南齊方面，齊明帝蕭鸞在位，但真正主持軍政與邊防的是太傅、錄尚書事蕭道成：他從479年北魏攻壽春、在淮上一線擊退魏軍起家，此後以冠軍將軍、徐州刺史等職一路升遷，邊軍的調度與糧秣長期攥在他手中。齊的兵制並不整齊，中央有羽林等宿衛，各州有州鎮兵，另有大量募來的雜兵與宗室諸王的部曲；豫章王蕭嶷、竟陵王蕭暕等宗室先後出鎮揚州、荊州，兵權因此分散，朝廷要靠一紙詔書才能把外兵調離本鎮。北魏方面，孝文帝拓跋宏於494年遷都洛陽，以漢制改造國家，兵員主力是六鎮鎮兵與京畿騎兵，輔以新附的漢人編戶所出步兵，騎兵以拓跋部舊有的騎射傳統為骨幹，配長槊、弓箭與皮甲札甲，攻城器械與水軍則遠不如南朝。補給走黃河水運與洛陽至南陽的陸路，遠征深入則糧道拉長、容易被人切斷。整體看，齊握有城防、弩砲與江南的後勤，魏握有騎兵、箭雨與北方的兵源，這是一場守方拿工事換遠征方拿速度的較量。
countriesEn: The Battle of Nanyang was a frontier engagement between the Southern Qi and the Northern Wei fought in 497 in the region of Nanyang and Yiyang. The two sides were the Qi of Jiankang and the Northern Wei, whose capital had only recently been moved to Luoyang. On the Qi side Emperor Ming of Qi, Xiao Luan, was on the throne, but the real control of military affairs and of the frontier belonged to the Grand Tutor and Director of the Secretariat, Xiao Daocheng: he had made his name by throwing back the Wei attack on Shouchun and holding the line on the Huai in 479, and had risen since through posts such as General Victorious in Battle and Inspector of Xu, so that the dispatch of the frontier troops and their supplies long remained in his hands. The military system of Qi was untidy. The centre had palace guards such as the Feathered Forest, the provinces held provincial and commandery troops, and alongside these stood many recruited irregulars and the personal contingents of the imperial princes; princes of the Yuqiang and Jingling lines, Xiao Yi and Xiao Jiao, were posted in turn to Yangzhou and Jingzhou, so that military authority was dispersed and the court could only pull a provincial army away from its own command by issuing an imperial writ. On the Wei side Emperor Xiaowen, Tuoba Hong, had moved the capital to Luoyang in 494 and was remaking the state on Chinese institutions. The core of his army was cavalry from the Six Garrisons and the capital districts, supported by infantry from the newly enrolled Han households. That cavalry rested on the old Tuoba tradition of mounted archery and carried long lances, bows, and leather or lamellar armour, while its siege engines and its navy were far weaker than those of the southern courts. Supply ran by the Yellow River and by road from Luoyang to Nanyang, and a deep advance stretched that line until it could be cut. In the balance, Qi held fortifications, powerful crossbows and the logistical resources of the south, while Wei held cavalry, massed arrows and the man-power of the north: this was a contest in which the defenders traded works of fortification for the speed of the invaders.
people: 南陽之戰的指揮層，齊的一邊集中在皇族與權臣。齊明帝蕭鸞在位九年，晚年多病，疑心宗室與邊將，把兵柄交給太傅蕭道成。蕭道成是琅琊臨沂人，出身寒微，以軍功起家，先後為冠軍將軍、徐州刺史，479年北魏攻壽春時以孤軍拒敵而名聲大震，此後逐步掌控中樞，494年之後加太傅、錄尚書事，其府第車馬填塞，遠近親友並送儀仗，宮廷與外朝的奏事都先送到他府上。實際在南陽方向用兵的齊軍將領，見於《南齊書》與《資治通鑑》者只有寥寥數語，姓名多不可考，只能確認各郡縣守將各自負責城守，朝廷再以中軍與州兵往援。魏的一邊，主帥是孝文帝拓跋宏本人，他自494年遷都之後把洛陽變成前進基地，每逢南征多御駕親至，行軍與駐紮由大將軍、領軍府一類漢式幕府編制承擔，前線的鎮將、軍將多出自六鎮與京畿宿衛，姓名散見《魏書·官氏志》而無詳細戰記。可以確定的一點是，這場戰役的指揮重心不在哪一名將領，而在兩位君主對邊防的取捨：蕭鸞要守住南方的疆界，拓跋宏要在遷都之後為帝國找出南面的邊界。兩人後來都走了很遠：蕭鸞499年病死，蕭道成502年代齊建梁；拓跋宏499年病逝於洛陽，統一南北的事業留給了他的後人。
peopleEn: The command on the Qi side was concentrated in the imperial house and its leading minister. Emperor Ming of Qi, Xiao Luan, reigned for nine years; in his later years he was often ill and suspicious of the princes and of the frontier commanders, and he handed the military authority to the Grand Tutor Xiao Daocheng. Xiao Daocheng was a native of Linyi in Langya who came from a poor family and rose on military merit, serving as General Victorious in Battle and Inspector of Xu before he made his name by holding off the Wei with a single force when the northerners attacked Shouchun in 479. He then took the central government into his hands step by step, and after 494 was given the additional titles of Grand Tutor and Director of the Secretariat; carriages and horses filled his residence, relatives and friends from near and far sent him ceremonial escorts, and petitions from both the inner and the outer court were brought to his door first. The Qi commanders actually operating in the Nanyang direction are named in the Book of Southern Qi and in the Comprehensive Mirror in only a few phrases and their names cannot be recovered; all that can be confirmed is that each commandery and county garrison was responsible for its own city defence, with the Central Army and provincial troops sent to support them. On the Wei side the commander in chief was Xiaowen himself, Tuoba Hong, who from 494 onward turned Luoyang into the base for his advance south and personally rode with the army on every campaign, the march and the quarters of the troops being organised by the Chinese-style staffs of the General-in-Chief and the Directorate of the Palace Guard, while the frontier commanders and generals were drawn mostly from the Six Garrisons and the capital guard, their names scattered through the Official Registers of the Wei history with no detailed account of the fighting. What can be established is that the command of this battle did not turn on any single general but on the choices two monarchs made about the frontier: Xiao Luan needed to hold the southern boundary, and Tuoba Hong needed to find the southern edge of an empire that had just moved its capital. Both went a long way afterwards. Xiao Luan died of illness in 499, and in 502 Xiao Daocheng deposed the last Qi emperor and founded Liang. Tuoba Hong died of illness at Luoyang in 499, and the work of uniting north and south was left to his successors.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘重步兵：公元前5世紀希臘方陣的核心，手持直徑約六十至九十厘米的圓盾，配多投矛與短劍，排成縱深八列的密集方陣。它不在南陽之戰的現場——497年的楚豫邊界上沒有希臘人，也沒有希臘式方陣——但把它放進這場戰役的裝備對照裡，反而能看清兩種步兵答案的分歧與一致。齊軍的近戰主力是刀盾兵與長槊兵，披札甲，持環首刀與大盾，射手用臂弩與腰弩，重裝火力集中在床弩、均弩與數量充足的重箭；北魏的步兵多來自新附的漢人編戶，配大盾與長矛，馬上的軍人則用短槊、弓箭與皮甲，鎧甲比例低但速度與衝量高。攻城一方是北魏的弱項：南朝有撞車、拍車、木鵰、巢車與雲梯等成系列的器械，北方初期的攻城多靠突城與圍城斷糧，而不是器械對攻。要比較的其實是同一件事：希臘重步兵用圓盾把個人連成一面牆，靠遮蔽換厚度；南齊的刀盾兵用大盾與槊陣換到同樣的效果，卻沒有希臘人那樣整齊的列陣，也沒有那樣重的負擔；北魏的騎兵則完全不靠方陣，而靠速度、箭雨與分割。當一支軍隊的正面被騎兵反覆撞擊時，希臘人的答案是把方陣拉深，齊軍的答案是把盾牆釘在城牆與拒馬之間，魏軍的答案則是拉開射界、在騎兵衝鋒之前先用箭削掉守軍。武器本身沒有出現在這場戰役，但它標示的那個問題——怎樣讓互相遮蔽的步兵面對衝鋒——正是南陽城牆上反覆回答的問題。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek hoplite: the core of the Greek phalanx of the fifth century BC, carrying a round shield of roughly sixty to ninety centimetres in diameter, a long thrusting spear and a short sword, drawn up in a dense formation eight ranks deep. It was not present on the field of Nanyang — there were no Greeks on the Chu–Yu frontier in 497, and no Greek phalanx either — but placed in a comparison of the equipment of this battle it shows where two answers about infantry diverge and where they meet. The close combat core of the Qi army was made up of men with sword and shield and of spearmen: they wore lamellar armour, carried ring-pommel swords and large shields, their archers used crossbows of the arm and waist types, and their heavy punch was concentrated in bed crossbows, bolt crossbows and a generous supply of heavy arrows. The Wei infantry came largely from the newly enrolled Han households and were equipped with large shields and long spears, while the men on horseback used short lances, bows and leather armour: a low proportion of armour, but a high one of speed and impact. Siegecraft was the weak side of the Northern Wei. The southern courts possessed whole series of engines — battering rams, rammers, wooden crania, siege towers and scaling ladders — whereas early northern siege work relied on surprise assault and on starving the defenders out rather than on a duel of engines. What the comparison really comes down to is one thing. The Greek hoplite joined individual men into a wall with the round shield, buying thickness with cover. The Qi's men with sword and shield bought the same effect with large shields and a wall of spears, without the Greek order or the Greek weight of burden. The Wei cavalry relied on no phalanx at all but on speed, arrow rain and fragmentation. When a formation is battered again and again by cavalry, the Greek answer was to deepen the phalanx, the Qi answer was to nail the shield wall between the city wall and the caltrops, and the Wei answer was to open up the shooting arc and thin the defenders with arrows before the charge went in. The weapon itself never appeared in this battle, but the problem it marks — how to make mutually shielding infantry stand up to a charge — is exactly the problem that was answered again and again on the walls of Nanyang.
tactics: 雙方的打法可以從地勢與後勤反推。南陽郡治宛城建在漢水北岸、方城山麓，東接淮漢間的平原與沼澤，西連武關、藍田的山道，是關中與江淮之間的鎖鑰；北魏要取南陽，不是為了一城之地，而是要順著漢水打開通向襄陽與江陵的門戶。魏軍的戰法是先以游騎搜索逼近，迫敵示形，然後以大批弓騎齊射覆蓋守軍陣前，等騎兵衝鋒撕開缺口，再下馬步戰收拾潰兵；追擊時不求遠，只在敵軍失去秩序的當下分割殲滅，騎兵與步兵之間靠旗鼓與傳令維持協同。齊軍的戰法更節省：據城不野戰，以弩砲壓制騎兵，環城佈拒馬與鹿角，把弓弩手放在城頭居高臨下，槊兵與刀盾兵在城門內列陣待敵，援軍到了再合圍反擊。糧道是魏軍真正的弱點：南陽距洛陽約一百八十公里，糧車與輜重走陸路，遇上雨季與泥濘便寸步難行，齊軍只要派輕騎切斷方城、舞陰一線的運輸線，魏軍就必須退兵，否則深入之後就是斷糧。齊軍的另一個手段是水網：漢水、淮水與沿途陂塘使北魏的騎兵無法展開成大規模衝鋒，只得分隊作戰。整體而言，雙方都在避免一場雙方都承受不起的決戰：魏軍要的是速戰速決，齊軍要的是拖到魏軍糧盡。
tacticsEn: The way the two sides fought can be read backwards from the ground and the logistics. The commandery seat of Nanyang, Wancheng, stood on the north bank of the Han at the foot of Mount Fangcheng, with the marshes and plains between the Huai and the Han to the east and the passes toward Wuguan and Lantian to the west, a lock between Guanzhong and the rivers. For the Northern Wei to take Nanyang was not a matter of seizing one city but of opening the road along the Han towards Xiangyang and Jiangling. The Wei method was to send out rider patrols to press close and force the enemy to show himself, then cover the defenders in front of their line with massed arrows from horse archers, let the charge of the cavalry open a gap, and bring dismounted infantry in to finish what had broken; in the pursuit they did not press far, but destroyed the enemy in fragments at the moment the enemy had lost its order, the cavalry and the foot being kept in concert by flags, drums and messengers. The Qi method was more economical: they stood in their cities rather than fighting in the open, used the crossbows to pin the cavalry, ringed the walls with caltrops and spiked barricades, posted the crossbowmen on the wall so they shot from above, held the spearmen and the men with sword and shield in formation inside the gates, and counter-attacked in force once the relieving troops had arrived. The Wei weak point was the supply line. Nanyang lies about one hundred and eighty kilometres from Luoyang, the grain wagons and baggage trains travelled by road, and in the rainy season the roads turned to mud that barely moved a wheel; if the Qi sent light horse to cut the transport line through Fangcheng and Wuyin, the Wei had to withdraw, because a deep advance without supplies is a campaign that ends by itself. The Qi had a second lever, the network of water. The Han, the Huai and the reservoirs along the route broke the Wei cavalry into small detachments that could not mass for a charge. In the end both sides were trying to avoid a decisive battle that neither could afford: the Wei needed speed, the Qi needed the Wei to run out of food.
data: 可核對的數字集中在年份、里程與人口，而不是戰果。戰役發生在公元497年，即南齊明帝永明九年、北魏孝文帝太和二十一年；北魏494年遷都洛陽，495年孝文帝曾御駕南伐至壽春而被蕭道成擊退，497年再度用兵南陽，503年北魏才最終攻下義陽、鍾離，把邊界線向南推移。距離上，洛陽至南陽郡治約一百八十公里，至義陽約三百公里，至壽春約四百六十公里；南陽到建康的路程更超過一千公里，齊軍主力只能靠江淮與漢水的水陸轉運。所有編年都只記年不記月日，齊的《南齊書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下南陽之戰的日期、兵員與勝負數字；可以確定的規模只有：北魏投入的是六鎮與京畿的精騎加各州徵兵，齊投入的是南陽、義陽、壽春三個方向的州鎮兵與中央援軍，雙方的投入都遠大於此前任何一次邊界衝突，但都沒有留下可靠統計。人口方面有一條與戰局直接相關的數字：《資治通鑑》記太和十一年（487）齊地叛逃投魏者達五十餘萬眾，魏人給糧一月遣還；遷都之後北方人口南流的規模，遠超魏軍每次南征能帶走的兵員。武器方面沒有留下可核的數目：弩的張數、床弩與均弩的配備數、魏軍的馬鎧比例，都只能從制度推測。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked concern dates, distances and population, not results. The battle was fought in 497, which is the ninth year of Yongming under Emperor Ming of Qi and the twenty-first year of Taihe under Emperor Xiaowen of the Northern Wei. The Wei had moved the capital to Luoyang in 494; in 495 Xiaowen had ridden south himself to Shouchun and been thrown back by Xiao Daocheng; in 497 he used his troops against Nanyang once more, and it was only in 503 that the Northern Wei finally took Yiyang and Zhongli and pushed the boundary south. As for distances, Luoyang lies about one hundred and eighty kilometres from the commandery seat of Nanyang, about three hundred from Yiyang and about four hundred and sixty from Shouchun; the road from Nanyang to Jiankang runs well over a thousand kilometres, so the bulk of the Qi army could only be shifted by water and land along the Huai, the Yangtze and the Han. Every chronicle records the year and not the month or the day, and neither the Book of Southern Qi nor the Comprehensive Mirror leaves behind the date, the numbers of men, or the score of the battle. The only scale that can be established is this: the Wei committed cavalry from the Six Garrisons and the capital districts together with levies from the provinces, while Qi committed the provincial and commandery troops of the Nanyang, Yiyang and Shouchun fronts together with the Central Army as reinforcement; on both sides the commitment was far larger than in any earlier clash on this frontier, but neither left a reliable count. One figure about population bears directly on the war: the Comprehensive Mirror records that in the eleventh year of Taihe, 487, more than five hundred thousand people from Qi fled over to the Wei, who fed them for a month and then sent them back. The scale of the northern population moving south after the move of the capital was far greater than the number of soldiers the Wei could carry on any single campaign. Nothing countable survives about the weapons: the numbers of crossbows, the establishment of bed and bolt crossbows, and the proportion of armoured horses among the Wei can only be inferred from the institutional arrangements.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最直接的一層是地理：南陽扼住漢水北岸，東出淮漢、西連關中，是北魏南下江淮的必經之地；魏人不拿下南陽，騎兵就只能停在汝、淮一線的平原上挨打，而齊人守住宛城與方城，就等於把北方的門插在門框上。第二層是孝文帝的國家工程：494年遷都洛陽之後，拓跋宏要做的不是守成，而是把新都變成可以向南方用兵的基地——軍械、馬匹、糧秣、屯田、漢人將領的編制都在這幾年裡被重新整理，495年南伐受挫更刺激了北魏要在下一次攻勢中把面子補回來。第三層是齊朝內部的裂痕：明帝晚年多疑，宗室諸王出鎮州郡而兵權歸於己，朝廷不得不用反覆的徵召和召回來控制他們；蕭道成在邊軍上的長期經營讓南線的兵權集中到一個人手裡，這對南齊是效率，對明帝卻是另一種威脅。於是同一支軍隊在兩種考慮下被推向前線：齊要守，卻不肯讓守軍的指揮權徹底獨立；魏要攻，攻勢又必須配合洛陽方面的整體安排。戰爭的爆發點其實在南陽境內的接觸點：只要魏騎兵推進到與齊軍前哨相遇的程度，兩個朝代都不可能再退回去談判。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause behind the fighting. The most immediate was geography. Nanyang grips the north bank of the Han, running east towards the Huai and Han plains and west towards Guanzhong, and it is the unavoidable road for the Northern Wei to march south towards the rivers. Without Nanyang the Wei cavalry could only stand on the plains around Ru and the Huai and take the beating; by holding Wancheng and Fangcheng, the Qi had driven the northern door into its frame. The second layer was the state works of Emperor Xiaowen. After the move to Luoyang in 494, Tuoba Hong was not after conserving what he had but after turning the new capital into a base from which the south could be attacked: the armaments, the horses, the grain, the military colonies and the organisation of Han commanders were all being rearranged in those years, and the rebuff of 495 only sharpened the Wei determination to make good the loss on the next offensive. The third layer was the fissure inside the Qi. Emperor Ming was suspicious in his later years; the princes of the clan were posted to commanderies and prefectures with the troops in their own hands, and the court had to control them by repeated calls in and recalls out; the long command of the frontier army by Xiao Daocheng concentrated the military power of the southern line in one man's hands, which was efficiency for the Qi but a different kind of threat to the emperor. The same army was therefore pushed to the front under two sets of reasoning at once: the Qi had to hold but would not let the field command become truly independent, and the Wei had to attack but had to fit its offensive into the general arrangements made at Luoyang. The spark lay in the point of contact inside Nanyang territory: once the Wei cavalry had pushed forward until it met the Qi outposts, neither dynasty could step back and negotiate.
impact: 這一仗沒有改變南北對峙的大格局，卻在三個地方留下了痕跡。第一是邊界：497年後南陽、義陽仍在南齊手中，北魏直到503年才奪取義陽、鍾離，淮河作為南北分界線又維持了數年；直到魏軍學會用船隊跨越江淮、南朝也學會用鐵騎與弩砲反擊之後，邊界才不再以山脈和江河為限。第二是北魏的國家形態：每一場南征都在加深魏的漢化——漢人將領進入幕府、漢式軍令與糧秣制度落地、北方流民被編戶屯田並且在戰線後方安置，魏因此從一個草原聯盟慢慢變成能持續遠征的帝國。第三是南齊的制度壓力：南線反覆用兵，州鎮兵與中央禁軍之間的裂痕越來越大，明帝對宗室的清洗在戰後更加急迫，499年明帝病死、502年蕭道成廢齊恭帝自立為帝，南齊四十七年的國祚就這樣收場。也就是說，南陽之戰真正改變的不是地圖，而是齊朝的心理狀態：它讓蕭道成相信南線的軍功可以換來權力，也讓明帝相信每一個握兵的人都在覬覦皇位。戰爭結束時，兩個王朝都比開戰前更清楚自己的對手是誰。
impactEn: This battle did not alter the great pattern of the north-south confrontation, but it left marks in three places. The first was the boundary. After 497 Nanyang and Yiyang were still in the hands of the Southern Qi, and the Northern Wei did not seize Yiyang and Zhongli until 503, so the Huai went on serving as the dividing line for several more years; only after the Wei learned to carry fleets across the rivers and the southern courts learned to answer with armoured horse and crossbow did the frontier cease to be marked out by mountains and rivers. The second was the shape of the Wei state. Every campaign in the south deepened the sinicisation of the Wei: Han commanders entered the command staffs, Chinese-style orders and supply arrangements took root, and the northern refugees were enrolled as households, settled on military colonies and provisioned behind the front. The Wei thus turned slowly from a steppe confederation into an empire capable of carrying out distant campaigns. The third was the institutional pressure on the Qi. Repeated fighting on the southern line widened the crack between the provincial and commandery troops and the central palace guard, and the purge of the princes after the war grew more pressing: Emperor Ming died in 499, and in 502 Xiao Daocheng deposed the last Qi emperor and took the throne himself, ending the forty-seven years of the Southern Qi. In other words, what the Battle of Nanyang really changed was not the map but the mood of the Qi court. It taught Xiao Daocheng that military service on the southern frontier could be converted into power, and it taught Emperor Ming that every man who held troops was aiming at the throne. When the fighting ended, both dynasties knew more clearly than before who their opponent was.
result: 結果是北魏退兵、南陽未失。魏軍在宛城與方城一線受阻，攻城器械不足、騎兵在江淮地形上施展不開、糧道又不斷遭到威脅，沒有可行的辦法攻下南陽，最終撤回淮北，兩軍恢復到戰前的分界線上；齊軍守住了南陽郡與義陽，卻也沒能反擊深入，只做到把戰事擋在原處。兩軍的傷亡與損耗，史料沒有留下可以核對的數字，流傳下來的記載只有寥寥數行，因此能確定的結果只有三項：南陽仍在南齊手中、淮水仍是南北的界線、雙方都沒有取得決定性的優勢。三年之後的503年，北魏在同一條戰線上攻下義陽與鍾離，才真正把邊界線往南推；再往後四年，蕭道成廢齊自立，南北對峙的另一個回合開始。至於兩軍在宛城城牆與方城山麓之間的具體交鋒細節，傳世記載已不完整，只能從當時的城防配置、器械配備與後勤線推想其樣貌。
resultEn: The result was that the Northern Wei withdrew and Nanyang was not lost. The Wei army was checked on the line of Wancheng and Fangcheng: it lacked siege engines, its cavalry could not open up on the broken ground between the rivers, and its supply line was under constant threat, so there was no workable way to take Nanyang. In the end it withdrew north of the Huai and the two armies returned to the division line they had held before the campaign. The Qi army kept Nanyang commandery and Yiyang, but could not counter-attack into Wei territory either, and achieved nothing beyond holding the fighting where it stood. No verifiable figures survive for the losses in men and material on either side, and the account that has come down to us runs to only a few lines, so that only three results can be established: Nanyang remained in the hands of the Southern Qi, the Huai remained the boundary between north and south, and neither side gained a decisive advantage. In 503, three years later, the Northern Wei took Yiyang and Zhongli on the same front and only then truly pushed the boundary south; four years after that Xiao Daocheng deposed the Qi and took the throne himself, and the next round of the north-south confrontation began. As for the actual collision of the two armies between the walls of Wancheng and the slopes of Mount Fangcheng, the transmitted record is no longer complete, and its shape can only be reconstructed from the fortifications, the establishment of engines and the supply lines of the time.
